§3§lPurpose and quest§r
The Wireless Network Link Terminal installs Link Anchor covers on supported GT energy containers. Energy covers draw from the wireless grid, while power covers upload machine output. This quest requires crafting §11§r Link Terminal.

§3§lModes and interaction§r
Shift-right-click the terminal to switch Energy and Power modes; its texture indicates the active mode. The default grid interaction interval is §1600 ticks (30 seconds)§r, with §115%§r downlink loss and §10%§r uplink loss. Configure InteractionRateTicks and the losses in config/gtswn/gtswn_network.cfg. §cShorter intervals increase interaction frequency and processing overhead.§r

§3§lBuffers and operating requirements§r
Energy covers use a finite buffer with a default capacity of §1V × A × 800 EU§r; power covers use Long.MAX_VALUE as their buffer limit. The wireless EU grid supports cross-dimension transfer, while participating machines still need their chunks loaded.
